Lesson 10.2 · 36 of 78 · 24 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Pricing, APR, charges, tax and profitability

After this lesson you can:
  • Decompose borrower price and lender economics
  • Reconcile APR, fees, GST and schedule cash flows
  • Specify risk-based pricing without hidden discretion

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. The borrower price
  2. Pricing is a decision
  3. Economics and reconciliation
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. The borrower price

Nominal interest is only one component.

Processing fees, mandatory third-party charges, GST, insurance and timing of cash flows affect the amount received and total amount paid.

APR is the comparable all-in annualised cost disclosed through the KFS; its inputs must come from governed product and fee registries, not from free text.

2. Pricing is a decision

A pricing matrix can use risk grade, amount, tenor, channel or collateral band, but each input needs provenance and each adjustment needs an authority rule.

Dealer subvention and partner commission are commercial legs; they cannot be hidden as borrower charges.

Penal charges are separate, reasonable, disclosed and never capitalised.

3. Economics and reconciliation

The BA should trace one example from approved rate through APR sheet, amortisation, accounting entries, tax, partner payout and portfolio yield. Test boundary tiers, waived fees, refunds, cooling-off exits and rounding at every cash-flow boundary.

Regulatory anchors

  • RBI-KFS-2024 — APR and all borrower charges must be disclosed consistently.
  • RBI-FPC-PENAL — Penal charges cannot become penal interest or be capitalised.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Where this lives in LoanOS

  • Capability PRD-003 — Interest-method configuration.
  • Capability PRD-004 — Risk-based pricing matrices.
  • Capability PRD-005 — APR composition.
  • Capability PRD-006 — GST treatment.
  • Capability PRD-015 — Risk-adjusted product economics.

Retrieval practice

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. A mandatory valuation fee is deducted before disbursement. Where does it belong?

  1. Outside the loan cost
  2. In the governed charge set and APR cash flows
  3. Only in accounting
  4. Only in the agreement appendix
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. Mandatory charges affecting borrower cash flows belong in the KFS/APR computation and downstream accounting.
